description: Find cafes, restaurants, buildings, parks, schools, hospitals, transit stops, drinking water, or trails within a bounding box up to 0.5 degrees per axis. Returns OSM geometry and tags, subject to the output limit. Requires a subscription key or authorized x402 payment.

category.description: Mapped feature category; use overpass_query for arbitrary OSM tags.

limit.description: Maximum returned OSM objects, not a pagination guarantee.

responseMode.description: compact: inline when small, a result handle when large. handle: always a handle. raw: always the full body, however large.

name: find_features
